run_dense_tracking: run the CoTrackerPredictor forward method to compute dense tracks across all video frames
run_sparse_tracking: run the CoTrackerPredictor forward method with queries tensor to compute sparse point tracks
run_grid_tracking: run the CoTrackerPredictor forward method with grid_size to compute tracks on a regular grid
run_backward_tracking: run the CoTrackerPredictor forward method with backward_tracking to compute tracks in both directions
run_online_tracking: run the CoTrackerOnlinePredictor forward method to process video chunks incrementally for online tracking
